meta.title: Switch the stack to another worktree: proposed

frontend.label: UI step where the work started

nodes.label: Toolbar: Worktrees
nodes.explanation: The bar's Worktrees trigger shows the selected worktree's SEL-4 label ('main ~/acme' or 'Detached c521449 ~/acme/.worktrees/bisect', shortening the path on narrow widths) with accessible name 'Worktrees: main ~/acme' (SEL-4, WORD-1, WORD-11); a deleted running worktree adds the state as shape and word, '∅ fix-nav · deleted', and the collapsed badge reads '∅ dh · fix-nav deleted ▴' with its one-line notice (ACT-13, SURF-8, ACT-7). The trigger is one arrow stop: Alt+Ctrl+B, ArrowRight, Enter (KEY-3, KEY-4). The panel is an anchored popover clear of the notice stack and right-edge minimap, above docked chat, with >=3:1 button borders and fitted to every acceptance viewport (SURF-1, SURF-2, SURF-9, SURF-10). Focus starts in Find worktree at top; Tab moves to details-line remedies, then footer; Tab past last, Escape or outside click close it with focus returned (KEY-5, KEY-6, KEY-7, KEY-8, KEY-10). Hint line: '↑↓ Move · Enter Pick · Esc Close' (KEY-13, BAR-4). Resolves worktree-switch-10.

sources.label: Replaces: trigger label without SEL-4 path
Replaces: find field below the list

nodes.label: Status pages, crash view
nodes.explanation: Startup, recovery and app error pages render the shared worktree list, its details line, the reach line, Switch and Restart Stack, Return to Configured Worktree and Refresh Worktrees, even with the toolbar off, replacing today's native select with full paths, 40-character commit IDs and errors inside options (SURF-14, SEL-4, MENU-1, WORD-11). One component ships in both style entries, so every surface shows identical rows, words and accessible names. The crash view shows the same list when its cause is a deleted or blocked worktree, and a switch started there reports its progress and failure in the view (SURF-3). On an app's own 404 or 5xx, startup-and-recovery's notice holds the list collapsed under 'Is this route in another worktree?' (SURF-16, O5; error-pages-04 is startup-and-recovery's, related). A switch from any of them takes the same two steps, and its outcome shows on the page that loads next (FB-2). Resolves worktree-switch-03.

sources.label: Replaces: native select with full paths
Reuses: the same switch request

nodes.label: Read worktrees
nodes.explanation: Opening Worktrees, a status page's first check, Refresh Worktrees and Check Again read GET /__devhost__/worktrees (git worktree list, each worktree's manifest and service folders) and stop nothing (HOLD-4, O43, Backend 3). Rust main already leaves rejected running manifests to hot reload (worktree-switch-14 fixed at worktrees.rs:360-370), publishing 'edit not applied' (HOLD-6); Runtime::refresh_worktrees drops stop_group for deleted running worktrees too (O43). Each entry carries state, branch, head, configured, selected, running, notApplied and a structured reason, plus readAt ('Read 14:02', ACT-12, Backend 4). Both entry points (/__devhost__/worktrees and X-Devhost-Recovery: worktrees with Host check) enforce O36/O37 remote auth: this machine and passkey/paired remote browsers work alike; unauthenticated remote browsers get 403 'Sign in with passkey or pair this browser to use devhost here' with no paths, PIDs or owner IDs (HOLD-7, HOLD-8, Backend 12). Resolves network-exposure-03.

sources.label: Replaces: refresh_worktrees stop on deletion
Reuses: Group::refresh and belongs() check
Replaces: unauthenticated worktree routes

nodes.label: Find and pick a worktree
nodes.explanation: The shared worktree list, one component this flow ships with the one worktree-label builder (SURF-14, SEL-4, WORD-11): a combobox whose find field (Find worktree) and list share one shadow tree; ArrowUp and ArrowDown move the highlight, Enter picks it and never switches, and rows hold no controls (KEY-10, REV-2, KEY-9). Main worktree comes first, then linked worktrees by branch; a row reads 'fix-nav · 08c92af · ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav' with badges as shape and word: running, configured, unavailable, in use, blocked, deleted, edit not applied (ACT-13, WORD-6), in services-panel's shared state-words module. Find matches branch and path fuzzily, highlighted, and every worktree's HEAD by exact prefix, so '08c92a' finds fix-nav; no match reads 'No worktree has HEAD at 08c92aff' or 'No worktree matches "fixx"' with Clear Filter (SEL-10, STATE-2). The highlight starts on the selected worktree, and a deleted one is never preselected (SEL-4). Stack directory cards take the same label (stack-directory-03, related). Resolves worktree-switch-01.

sources.label: Replaces: fuzzy search on label and path only
Replaces: short commit only on detached rows

nodes.label: Details line below list
nodes.explanation: Below the list, outside it, a details line is headed by the highlighted row's label and reason and holds that row's remedies as Tab stops after Find worktree, updated as the highlight moves; it never covers another row's badges (KEY-10, MENU-4). A manifest that fails reads one structured line, the path written once: 'devhost.toml does not parse · line 13, services.api.port: strings cannot contain newlines'. When the config editor is on, it offers Edit at that line in the Configuration window; when off (the default), it shows devhost.toml:13 with Copy instead (editor support removed completely under O51; no Open or Open in Editor). Both forms include Copy Error with the original text and Check Again, because devhost does not watch non-running worktrees; validation issues list one per line (MENU-4, FAIL-2, WORD-7, HOLD-1, O51). A deleted worktree reads 'deleted · ~/acme/.worktrees/old is gone; Git still lists it' with git worktree prune to copy, never a raw Git exit status (WORD-7, SURF-15). Resolves worktree-switch-02.

sources.label: Replaces: badge popover with raw reason
Replaces: raw path-wrapped parse error

nodes.label: Switch and Restart Stack
nodes.explanation: The footer's Switch and Restart Stack (WORD-2, WORD-3, BAR-2) carries its reach line: 'Restarts all 6 services of Acme Shop from fix-nav ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav (repository acme) with new automatic ports · took 14 s last time', listing the six managed services in its tooltip and accessible description (SEL-5, SEL-1, REV-2, WORD-11). External services (managed = false) never block switching and trigger no warning (O7): removing blocked_reason at worktrees.rs:137-141 lets managed services restart from the target worktree while external services stay untouched and marked external in Services. In a named run it states what stays off (SEL-7); with chat off or incomplete scan it notes which agents were not checked (STATE-2). Picking is step 1 and pressing is step 2; it runs on one press when no other work is at stake (REV-1, REV-2). Unavailable with visible reason when running worktree picked, another operation runs (HOLD-3), disconnected (HOLD-2), unauthenticated remotely (HOLD-7, O36/O37), or deleted worktree blocked (HOLD-4). Resolves manifest-hot-reload-2-03.

sources.label: Replaces: external-service blocked_reason (O7)
Replaces: Switch, Retry and Return buttons

nodes.label: Other work asks first
nodes.explanation: Before it runs, the control names each item of other work the switch moves the page away from: chat conversations of this worktree that work or wait, by agent, title and mode ('Claude Code · Fix the nav · This worktree (live) · waiting for you', O1, WORD-11), terminal agents from running-agents, unsaved Configuration window drafts, held reloads with count ('Hold Reloads: 2 held reloads on this page are discarded by the switch'), and page context including any active tab share ('Page context: 2 marks · a mark whose element is gone after the reload is listed as lost; the tab share ends') (SEL-5, WORD-10). While any exists, the press expands in place into one question labelled 'Switch Acme Shop to fix-nav ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav and leave this work in main?' and described by its items and the six services (REV-3, REV-4). First choice in the button's place with focus and Enter: Answer First while an agent waits, else Review Drafts, else Cancel; Switch Anyway beside it. Escape or blank click cancels back to Switch and Restart Stack (KEY-7, KEY-8). Waiting requests stay answerable everywhere (REV-9, CC-38). Resolves chat-checkout-switch-02.

sources.label: Replaces: one click posts the switch at once

nodes.label: In use: Stop Stack asks
nodes.explanation: Highlighting an in use row fills the details line anchored below the list (SURF-2, KEY-10): 'In use by Acme Shop (hotfix) · hotfix ~/acme/.worktrees/hotfix · started 14:02 from a terminal · PID 95004', naming the stack with its worktree because two stacks share the name (WORD-1, SEL-4, WORD-11). It offers one Open Stack opening that stack's primary page in the same tab, the other routes under '4 more routes: api, admin, docs, mail' (SURF-10, SURF-15); the command devhost stop to run in ~/acme/.worktrees/hotfix, to copy (MENU-6, SEL-6); and Stop Stack, which asks every time, in place: 'Stop Acme Shop (hotfix) in ~/acme/.worktrees/hotfix? Its 6 services stop: web, api, docs, worker, admin and mail.', adding "Claude Code's turn in hotfix ends" when its agents work or wait (REV-1, REV-3, REV-4, CC-17). Cancel takes the pressed button's place with focus and Enter, Stop Acme Shop (hotfix) confirms, and Escape cancels with focus back on Stop Stack. Recovery pages' owner card renders the same (SURF-14). Resolves worktree-switch-07.

sources.label: Replaces: owner popover, Open stack per URL
Replaces: Stop stack posts at once

nodes.label: Unified parallel stop
nodes.explanation: Once confirmed, the confirm button stays as the busy control with focus: 'Stopping Acme Shop (hotfix) · 3 of 6 stopped · 12 s' (KEY-11, ACT-3). devhost re-checks the other stack's verified identity before every signal (ACT-14), records why beside its stack record before signalling, and stops it through the unified O30 parallel stop routine devhost stop uses (foreground and daemon stops concurrently from t = 0 inside the configurable 30 s default stopTimeout, 5s..10m, widening to max(stopTimeout, max_daemon_override + 10s) for O41 overrides > 20 s), never sending SIGKILL to a live supervisor while it still stops services (replacing the 10 s SHUTDOWN_GRACE_PERIOD kill at runtime.rs:450-468; REV-11, ACT-10, ACT-11, O30, CC-35, Backend 9). Outcome takes focus: 'Stopped Acme Shop (hotfix) · hotfix is free · 19 s', freeing the row in place (FB-2, FB-3). Survivors are named ('worker still runs · PID 95120 · port 4310'), keeping the row in use (FAIL-1). The stopped stack prints 'Stopped from Acme Shop (main ~/acme) at 14:05 · its Worktrees panel'. Resolves worktree-switch-13.

sources.label: Replaces: 10 s SHUTDOWN_GRACE_PERIOD stop RPC
Reuses: verified occupant identity lookup

nodes.label: Check, then switch
nodes.explanation: POST /__devhost__/worktrees takes an operationId (stored in sessionStorage first) and answers 202 Accepted with the switch record; a repeated ID returns that record without re-running (ACT-1, REV-12, CC-37, Backend 5). Before stopping anything, the runtime checks target registration, manifest/includes, selected managed service folders, and hostnames/fixed ports with any holder named; failures stop nothing, stale targets answer 409 with current state (REV-11, REV-13, FAIL-2). It writes a pending-switch record beside active.json without overwriting active.json until success (Backend 14), stops every managed service via verified containment (process-containment-01 fixed on Rust main in containment.rs), leaves external services untouched with no warning (O7), starts the run's selected services in the target (filtering out names absent from the target as missingNames instead of failing validate_requested_services at runtime.rs:747; Backend 1), and moves routes and hot reload. Another running operation answers 409 naming it (HOLD-3). Resolves worktree-switch-11 and worktree-switch-12.

sources.label: Replaces: active.json write before apply
Replaces: strict validate_requested_services
Replaces: prepare and select before apply

nodes.label: Progress in the panel
nodes.explanation: The confirm control stays where it was as the busy control and keeps focus, aria-busy and aria-disabled, never disabled: 'Switching to fix-nav · 3 of 6 stopped · 5 s', then 'Switching to fix-nav · 2 of 6 started · 9 s' (KEY-11, FB-9, WORD-4). Above it the panel lists the steps, updated at least once a second: 'Checked fix-nav', 'Stopping 6 services · 3 of 6 stopped', 'Starting in fix-nav · web · health check 2 s of 30 s', 'Moving routes and hot reload to fix-nav' (FB-1, STATE-1, ACT-4); services the switch stops are steps, never exits (FAIL-5). The trigger reads 'main · switching to fix-nav' and main's row keeps running until fix-nav's services run; the Services panel's rows read 'switching to fix-nav ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav', then starting, never failed, while external rows stay untouched (ACT-3, ACT-4, O7); changed marks clear against the new launch (ACT-8). The status stream stays open, so no lost-connection state appears (ACT-5, HOLD-2). Closed, progress becomes 'Switch to fix-nav · 2 of 6 started · 9 s' in the notice stack (FB-1, FB-8). Restart, Start and Alt+Ctrl+R say 'Switch to fix-nav is running · 2 of 6 started' (HOLD-3, SEL-2, MENU-3). Resolves worktree-switch-09.

sources.label: Replaces: one fixed 'Switching…' line
Replaces: label that names the target early

nodes.label: Switched to fix-nav
nodes.explanation: The switch succeeds only once every target managed service passed its health check, with no leftover answering in its place, and routes and hot reload follow the target (FB-5, ACT-11); only then does devhost save fix-nav in active.json, clear the pending record and reload the page at the same URL (worktree-switch-15). The reloaded page finds the outcome by its stored operationId and shows it once, focused and announced once: 'Switched acme from main ~/acme to fix-nav ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav: restarted 6 services · 6 of 6 running · 14 s' (FB-2, FB-3, KEY-6, FB-9, WORD-4, WORD-11). It names left-behind work ('Left in main: Claude Code · Fix the nav · This worktree (live) · waiting for you', linking its card; '2 held reloads discarded'; lost marks; FB-4, UNDO-2, O1). There is no Undo: 'main ~/acme' opens Worktrees with main highlighted as UNDO-5's way back; UNDO-1's rollback is the next step's. Closes after O14 reading time (7.8 s for 21 words) once pointer/focus leave while visible, pausing on unfocused arrival via document.hasFocus() (O53), and stays in the log (FB-6, FB-7). Chat keeps settings per stack (SEL-11, CC-9).

sources.label: Replaces: reload as soon as POST succeeds

nodes.label: Terminal: two lines
nodes.explanation: The stack's terminal prints one line when the switch starts and one outcome line, both worktrees named by SEL-4 label: 'Switching acme from main ~/acme to fix-nav ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav · restarting 6 services', then 'Switched acme from main ~/acme to fix-nav ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav: restarted 6 services · 6 of 6 running · 14 s', and no 'exited … waiting for a restart' line for any service the switch stopped (FB-10, FAIL-5, WORD-4, SEL-4, WORD-11, Backend 8). Agent output (AGENT=1) carries the same facts with absolute paths and a failure on one devhost: ERR: line (FB-11, WORD-9), and devhost stack info (short alias devhost status, O62) reports the last switch. A start restoring a linked worktree names it in its ready line: 'Ready in 4.2 s: https://shop.acme.test/ · acme runs fix-nav ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav, saved for this stack (configured: main ~/acme)' (FB-10, worktree-switch-12). No CLI switch command (MENU-6 note); Stop Stack's counterpart is devhost stop in that worktree's folder (SEL-6). Resolves worktree-switch-04's switch slice.

sources.label: Replaces: worktrees named by folder basename
Replaces: exit line for the switch's own stops

nodes.label: Returned to main
nodes.explanation: When a target service cannot start, devhost stops the target's services and starts the previous worktree's again, service by service, with its routes and hot reload; active.json never left main and the pending-switch record is removed (Backend 14). While restoring, the busy control and touched rows read 'Returning to main ~/acme' (UNDO-1, ACT-3, Backend 6). The panel stays open, the page does not reload, and the rollback outcome takes focus: 'Switch to fix-nav failed: web exited with code 1 before its health check. Returned to main ~/acme: 6 of 6 running · 21 s', with exit time, last lines and what ran (FAIL-1, FAIL-2, FAIL-3, FB-2). It leads with MENU-5's cause action (O32 setup command, else Retry Switch on one press naming its target; REV-1, REV-2). A service that cannot come back stays failed while the rest run: 'Returned to main ~/acme: 5 of 6 running · api still fails'; the failure stays until dismissed (FB-6). If devhost is SIGKILLed mid-switch, the next devhost start completes rollback: it runs main (active.json) and prints once 'Switch to fix-nav ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav, started 14:02, did not finish' (FB-10, FB-11). Resolves worktree-switch-15.

sources.label: Replaces: group-wide stop on failed restore
Reuses: atomic selection storage
Reuses: startup worktree build and restore

nodes.label: Needs setup: bun install
nodes.explanation: A fresh worktree without node_modules runs no automatic setup (O32) and never ends in a plain success (FB-5). When web exits during the switch, the rollback outcome leads with 'web in fix-nav could not resolve "react"; run bun install in ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav', the command to copy, then Retry Switch. When web's health check passes but the reloaded page is answered with 500, the outcome reads 'Switched acme to fix-nav ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav: 6 of 6 running · web answered 500 for this page', the app's answer shows with startup-and-recovery's notice (SURF-16), and that notice leads with MENU-5's needs-setup action, the install command to copy, then Restart (FAIL-3). devhost reads the failing service's last output lines with per-runtime missing-dependency matchers (Bun, Node, Python, Ruby) and derives the install command from the lockfile found in that worktree (bun.lock: bun install; Backend 10, O32). Resolves worktree-switch-06.

nodes.label: Deleted: Return first
nodes.explanation: When the next read finds the running worktree's folder gone or unregistered, devhost stops nothing (O43, HOLD-4): it publishes acme as blocked with one sentence, 'The worktree ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav was deleted; its services still run from it', processes still running keep running until the person's recovery, and devhost starts none of its services meanwhile (ACT-2, WORD-11). That sentence shows once in the status line and is the accessible description of every control it blocks: each Restart of acme's services, and Switch and Restart Stack while nothing is picked (HOLD-1, MENU-3). The toolbar and every recovery page lead with Return to Configured Worktree, then the shared list where fix-nav stays disabled as deleted and is never preselected, and Check Again, which clears the block when the folder is back without restarting anything (MENU-5, SEL-4). Return to Configured Worktree asks every time, in place: 'Return acme to main ~/acme and restart all 6 services with new automatic ports? Took 14 s last time.', Cancel focused (REV-1, REV-2, REV-4), then runs and reports like a switch. Resolves worktree-switch-05.

sources.label: Replaces: Restart <service> as the lead action
Replaces: Restart retrying a deleted worktree

cards.title: What changes versus today
items: Removed: external-service worktree-switch blocking and switch warnings (O7, worktrees.rs:137-141); the read that stops services for a deleted worktree (O43/HOLD-4, while rejected running manifests are already fixed on Rust main); Stop Stack's fixed 10 s stop request (O30 parallel stop replaces it); failing switches on target manifests missing a selected name; the status pages' native select, raw error chains, one Open Stack per route, Open in Editor (O51), 'checkout' as a noun (WORD-11); Restart as deleted-worktree lead and preselected deleted worktree; target="_blank" on Open Stack; saving active.json before services stop

Merged: the toolbar picker and status pages' select become one shared worktree list with one label builder (SURF-14, SEL-4, WORD-11); the in-use popover and badge popovers become one details line (KEY-10, SURF-2); Switch worktree and Switch and restart stack become Switch and Restart Stack (WORD-2)

New: the reach line; in-place question for other work with Answer First, Review Drafts or Cancel and Switch Anyway (with held-reload count and tab share); step-by-step progress in panel and activity line; reloaded-page outcome with left-behind work, O14/O53 timing and way back; Retry Switch; deleted state led by Return to Configured Worktree and Check Again; edit not applied on running row; structured reasons with Edit (or Copy when editor off) and Copy Error; commit-prefix find; read time; in-use details; Stop Stack question, progress, survivors and attribution; restored worktree at start; unfinished switch report; O36/O37 remote auth gating; switch operation record (ACT-1)

Changed: external services stay untouched across switches with no block or warning (O7); switches keep the run's selection and report missingNames (SEL-5); reading the list stops nothing even for deleted worktrees (HOLD-4, O43); Stop Stack and Return to Configured Worktree ask in place (REV-1, CC-17); Stop Stack uses O30 parallel shutdown with configurable 30 s default stopTimeout (5s..10m, CC-35); trigger shows SEL-4 worktree label; Find worktree at top matches commit prefix; Open Stack opens same tab; per-service rollback; terminal names both worktrees by label; unfinished switch restores prior worktree at next start (UNDO-1, FB-10)

Kept: no silent fallback to another worktree, other repositories running (owner rule; HOLD-4, O43); target validated before anything stops, with hostnames and fixed ports probed (REV-11); failed start rolls back to previous worktree with saved selection unchanged (UNDO-1); one switch at a time, named and refused with 409 (HOLD-3); selection saved per root manifest on success and restored on start; graceful stops cancel with prior worktree saved; Stop Stack verifies owner identity before every signal (ACT-14); status pages offer switch and Refresh Worktrees with toolbar off (CC-31); read-only Git with git worktree prune to copy; external services untouched; conversations bound to worktree and answerable everywhere (SEL-5, CC-38)
Conforms: a manifest of a worktree the stack does not run can be edited; the save is checked and kept and applies when the stack runs that worktree (UNDO-6; config-editor's Backend 14)

cards.title: Backend work
items: Keep selection and report missingNames: scope prepare/directories to requested names; replace strict validate_requested_services failure at runtime.rs:747 with missingNames filtering (Backend 1)
Remove external-service switch blocking (O7): delete blocked_reason assignment for !service.managed at worktrees.rs:137-141 so external services never block switching or warn (Backend 2)

Read stops nothing (O43): keep worktrees.rs:360-370 belongs check for rejected manifests (edit not applied) and drop stop_group for deleted running worktrees in runtime.rs:489-536, publishing blocked state (Backend 3, 13)
Structured worktree entries: state, branch, head/shortHead, configured, selected, running, notApplied, structured reason, in-use owner label/startedAt/mode, readAt (Backend 4)

Switch operation record: operationId, 202 Accepted, kind switch/return, from/to, origin, per-service steps, missingNames, leftBehind, outcome; 409/422 JSON errors; >=1/s stream with open status stream (Backend 5, 7; CC-37)

Per-service rollback in runtime.rs:871-900 without group-wide stop_group on failed restore; terminal start/outcome lines with SEL-4 labels and suppressed switch-stop exit lines in cliout.rs and runtime.rs:85-95 (Backend 6, 8)

Stop Stack through O30 unified parallel stop routine (30 s default stopTimeout, 5s..10m, O41 widening, never SIGKILLing live supervisor; stop-other progress, survivors, attribution); O32 per-runtime missing-dependency matchers (Backend 9, 10)

Record origins (ACT-1); O36/O37 shared-domain passkey and devhost pair auth on both entry points (403 unauthenticated, Host rule on recovery); pending-switch record beside active.json saved only on success (Backend 11, 12, 14)

cards.title: Contract changes
items: CC-17 & CC-35: Stop Stack asks first naming stack and services, then runs O30 unified parallel shutdown with configurable 30 s default stopTimeout (5s..10m) and names survivors

CC-31 & WORD-11: stacks/worktrees.md replaces 'checkout' with 'worktree' throughout, updates Switch and Restart Stack, Refresh Worktrees, Find worktree, in-use details, terminal lines, and removes editor source links (O51)

O7 & O43 & worktree-switch-15: stacks/worktrees.md and apps/devhost/AGENTS.md state that external services stay untouched and never block switches (O7), reading the list stops nothing while deleted running worktrees stay blocked until recovery (O43), and active.json saves only once a switch succeeds with unfinished switches named on next start

CC-24 & CC-22: services stopped for a switch never print as exits; terminal prints start and outcome lines naming both worktrees and names restored linked worktrees at start; devhost stack info / devhost status (O62) reports last operation

CC-37 & O36/O37: worktrees POST takes operationId and answers 202 Accepted with record (409/422 JSON errors); control-api.md Security model documents O36/O37 passkey/pair auth and 403 refusal on both worktree entry points

CC-32: CONTEXT.md adds unified Worktree term (main and linked working copies alike); CC-9 & CC-38 (agent-chat): chat settings per stack, conversations listed and answerable across worktrees; CC-4 (startup-and-recovery): app 404/5xx notice holds shared worktree list

items: Designed against alexgorbatchev/devhost at 190a8bb53e8cd903d2db0a92cb0886f29671607f (Rust main) and the shared UX pattern reference revision 7
Drawn from the frozen pre-Rust current diagram and the reconciled written proposal; sources cite verified Rust and UI code a step reuses or replaces at 190a8bb5, and steps with no code yet have none
